COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
UKHC010193492022
SPA/477/2022
In
Delay Condonation Application (IA No.2/2023)
Vinod Kumar & Others 
--Appellants
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand & Others 
--Respondents
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, C. J.
Hon’ble Subhash Upadhyay, J.
1. Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for 
the appellants.
2. Mr. J.C. Pande, learned Standing Counsel 
for the State. 
3. Mr. Ayush Khali, learned counsel holding 
brief of Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, learned counsel 
for the respondent nos.2 and 3.
4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5. Although, there is considerable delay in 
filing the instant appeal, but, since the question 
as to whether the relaxation granted by the 
State Government was inconsonance with the 
Act, 2009 or not and is affecting large number 
of persons, therefore, we deem it fit in the 
interest of justice that the appeal be heard on 
merits.
6. Accordingly, the delay is condoned.
7. Office is directed to allot the regular 
number to instant appeal.
8. List this appeal for hearing in due course. 
(Subhash Upadhyay, J.)(Manoj Kumar Gupta, C.J.)
